questions.prompt: How many bits are in one byte?

questions.explanation:
B. 3

Divide 24 by 8 to get 3 bytes.

questions.prompt: Does every UTF-8 character use the same number of bytes?
options: A. Yes, every character uses 1 byte
B. No, it can use 1–4 bytes depending on the character
C. Yes, every character uses 8 bytes
questions.answer: B. No, it can use 1–4 bytes depending on the character
questions.explanation:
B. No, it can use 1–4 bytes depending on the character

UTF-8 is variable length; some visible symbols also combine several code points.

questions.prompt: How many bytes is an uncompressed 24-bit RGB pixel?
questions.explanation:
C. 3

24 bits divided by 8 equals 3 bytes.

questions.prompt: Which calculation estimates raw storage for a 1920 × 1080 RGB image?
questions.explanation:
B. 1920 × 1080 × 3 bytes

Pixel count is width × height, with 3 bytes for each RGB pixel.
